edits.new: `DeviationWorkflow` is the one workflow the ownership rows give S8. This baseline fixes its input, its two signals and the five activities the branch adds; the other branches of the workflow are the sibling stories'. The activity names are a design choice of the application story, and the baseline carries them so that the workflow history is stable. The stage timer's pause is applied by rwb-case on the EV-06 subscription and is not an activity of this service. The approval of a deviation is a step inside `DeviationWorkflow`, taken by the role the code assigns; the decision-record library writes the entry and its hash, and no ApprovalWorkflow edge to rwb-decision (P7) is added while that question is open (GAP-1820). The workflow is started when an agent or officer flags the deviation (EV-06 starts screening) or when universal rules R-UNI-04 to 09 fire; its workflow ID form is Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-11487) and its duplicate-start policy is Not specified in the source documents (CG-ALL-11487).
